assets.alt: Brand logo (ia-logo)
assets.licence: The brand's own — it owns this file
rules: The brand logo: keep its proportions; never recolour, stretch, rotate or redraw it.
Give it clear space at least the height of its own cap letters, on a plain ground.
Black on white or IA's light greys only; on IA blue, black or a photo use ia-logo-white.
Keep clear space of at least the monogram's height on every side.
Never recolour it blue, stretch it, outline it or set the wordmark in another face.
Smallest size: 24px tall on screen, 8mm in print.

assets.alt: IA's six-spoke asterisk in IA blue
assets.licence: The brand's own — it owns this file
rules: One asterisk per page, slide or panel: it marks the single statement that matters.

Never as a bullet, a list marker, a pattern or a background.
